# `api.jobs.rates.request`

> `POST /job/{jobDisplayId}/rates` — ACPortal

**Python**

```python
api.jobs.rates.request(job_display_id: int, **kwargs: Any) -> HandlingUnitRates
```

**CLI**

```bash
ab jobs rates request <job_display_id> [--body ...]
```

Get carrier rates for handling units, origin, destination, and requested date.

## Request body — `HandlingUnitRateRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shipOutDate` | `datetime` | no | Requested shipment date and time; required by non-UPS carriers. |
| `transportationAddOns` | `Optional[list[JobServiceAddOnModelInput]]` | no | Transportation add ons. |
| `rateSources` | `Optional[list[Literal[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 14, 15, 20]]]` | no | Rate sources. |
| `handlingUnits` | `list[TransportationHandlingUnitModelInput]` | yes | Handling units included in this rate request. |
| `originAddress` | `RateRequestAddressModelInput` | yes | Origin address. |
| `destinationAddress` | `RateRequestAddressModelInput` | yes | Destination address. |
| `skipCache` | `bool` | no | Skip cache. |

## Response

Returns `HandlingUnitRates`.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `providers` | `Optional[list[CarrierProviderResult]]` | no | Providers. |
| `errors` | `Optional[list[CarrierProviderMessageResult]]` | no | Errors. |
| `warnings` | `Optional[list[CarrierProviderMessageResult]]` | no | Warnings. |
| `filtrationMessages` | `Optional[list[CarrierProviderMessageResult]]` | no | Filtration messages. |
| `ratesKey` | `Optional[str]` | no | Opaque key returned by the rate request; required when selecting a quote. |
| `requestSnapshot` | `Optional[RateRequestSnapshotResult]` | no | Request snapshot. |
